data.title: 山田杏奈 · 图书馆书架死角偷吃薯片的受惊回眸·「市川……嘘！不许告诉图书委员！」
data.description: 午休的图书室里，杏奈躲在书架间吃薯片，腮帮子还鼓着，就看见你走进过道。她穿着整齐的校服和米色开衫，一手把零食袋藏到背后，另一手赶紧把食指抵在唇边，请你替她保守这个小秘密。
data.location: 图书室高耸书架死角矮凳前
data.action: 蹲在书架间，一手藏薯片袋，另一手竖指示意安静，嘴里还含着零食。
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, action and face visible
data.promptProse: Caught with her cheeks full of potato chips, Anna Yamada turns toward the visitor in the narrow library aisle. She crouches in her buttoned school blouse and beige cardigan, quickly hiding the snack bag behind her back with one hand. Her other index finger asks for silence at her lips, while her brown eyes widen in surprise. Soft lunchtime window light falls between the bookshelves and catches the crinkled corner of the bag.
